|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[His Destiny]] (version 3 of 3). It is the current text. Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
* '''Original''' ([[His Destiny]]): the card image documented in the repository (18 June 2023)<ref name="ht-04fafe9">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/04fafe9a4fc2c8a87e045ba98e3a4c685106d50c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/hires/hisdestiny.png as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (current publisher endpoint: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/hisdestiny.gif res.starwarsccg.org]; may serve a later printing) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/04fafe9a4fc2c8a87e045ba98e3a4c685106d50c 04fafe9] “Set 21 plus stuff”, 18 June 2023.</ref> prints: “If He Is The Chosen One on table, deploy on table. Opponent’s total Force generation is -1 (and your total power everywhere is +1) for each [Endor] or [Death Star II] battleground you occupy (limit 2). Once per turn, if a card was just stacked on I Feel The Conflict, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. May lose 2 Force to cancel You Are Beaten or an attempt to steal Luke’s Lightsaber. During your move phase, may turn a card stacked on I Feel The Conflict face up to relocate Luke between a battleground site and your Death Star II site.”<ref name="cj-1ad7bd9">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/1ad7bd9829001762108e1dd1bc4d9900e062de52 swccg-card-json commit 1ad7bd9] “all of the LS V21 cards” (17 June 2023) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[His Destiny (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [[Media:Virtual Set 21 June 2023 (recovered).pdf|Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition]] (eight pages; June 2023 printed footer; [[:File:Virtual Set 21 June 2023 (recovered).pdf|source details]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 6, file created 17 June 2023: “If He Is The Chosen One on table, deploy on table. Opponent's total Force generation is -1 (and your total power everywhere is +1) for each [Endor] or [Death Star II] battleground you occupy (limit 2). Once per turn, if a card was just stacked on I Feel The Conflict, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. May lose 2 Force to cancel You Are Beaten or an attempt to steal Luke's Lightsaber. During your move phase, may turn a card stacked on I Feel The Conflict face up to relocate Luke between a battleground site and your Death Star II site.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[His Destiny]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[His Destiny]] (published 18 June 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•His Destiny”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the errata card image (29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata)<ref name="ht-efc26cd">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/hires/hisdestiny.png as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (current publisher endpoint: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/hisdestiny.gif res.starwarsccg.org]; may serve a later printing) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata.</ref> prints: “If He Is The Chosen One on table, deploy on table. Indeed You Are Powerful: Once per turn, if you just won a battle or duel, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. I Have To Face Him: Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Luke to same battleground as Prophecy Of The Force. Father, Please!: Non-[Set 13] Anakin Skywalker does not cause Force loss and, once per game, you may lose 1 Force to play it from outside your deck as if from hand.”<ref name="cj-e1137c3">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/e1137c35d73827551e0f70f68c2e8da6ea8beb6a swccg-card-json commit e1137c3] “More cards and fixes” (15 January 2025) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The text after “If He Is The Chosen One on table, deploy on table.” was rewritten under three named headings. Removed: the Force generation −1 / power +1 bonus for each [Endor] or [Death Star II] battleground you occupy, the I Feel The Conflict trigger for the Reserve Deck peek, “May lose 2 Force to cancel You Are Beaten or an attempt to steal Luke’s Lightsaber.” and the move-phase relocation by turning a stacked card face up. New: “Indeed You Are Powerful: Once per turn, if you just won a battle or duel, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. I Have To Face Him: Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Luke to same battleground as Prophecy Of The Force. Father, Please!: Non-[Set 13] Anakin Skywalker does not cause Force loss and, once per game, you may lose 1 Force to play it from outside your deck as if from hand.” The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
